test_title: PYST 217: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 3rd Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c9d52205610f923e1e91b9920dcb4c09ca0ead56ef220130741de93e664bcf.png] 

**Logic : The difference between the position value is 5.**

So,

 
• RVB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196ab653bc2c1f2430ba3c28524d0de123ce2c0ddff649e583199072259a3c32.png] 

 
• GLQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b4c0f5a5e9c52a4f1f5d883c5343e27eb1fc78112444dfff2812146dc600b05.png] 

 
• TYD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef70e7ee827d09126b515d86561b3f3cf44d4c055d196cbb9e4992e541658d72.png] ​

 
• NSX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3ebf4b6d20fc14c10fa5f2453c441a50de2db8b071bb5a5b3e4d035e4b733cf.png] 

Thus, Only in RVB the difference between the position value of each letter is not 5.

Hence, **"RVB"** is the correct answer.
